{{Top}}
The '''starflower''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of diurnal [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. The golden-yellow flowers of this plant were the favored food of [[stump lizard]]s.
